claim_boundary: Plan/Spec/RED only: no production load test, no GA readiness, no live traffic, and no UI/native implementation are claimed by this high-volume group HR fixture.

policy_determinism.policy: The same input must produce the same output across repeated high-volume replay runs. Every employee lifecycle, leave/attendance, sensitive-read, and compliance-threshold decision carries an idempotency key, stable ordering, and decision hash so concurrency does not hide policy drift.
must_reject: wall-clock randomness in policy decisions
unordered batch aggregation that changes decision hash output
idempotency key collisions across tenants or legal entities

tenant_legal_entity_isolation.policy: Every scenario must preserve tenant_id and legal_entity_id through domain, app, storage/RLS, PDP, and audit evidence. Negative replay must prove cross-tenant and cross-legal-entity requests fail closed with no aggregate leakage.
must_assert: tenant_id is present in every workload item and evidence record
legal_entity_id is present in lifecycle, leave/attendance, sensitive-read, storage, and audit evidence
Postgres/RLS and idempotency proof constrains tenant_id plus legal_entity_id
Tenant/RBAC PDP evidence is required before sensitive-read runtime access
negative replay rejects cross-tenant and cross-legal-entity records
no aggregate leakage appears in counters, histograms, logs, traces, or error envelopes

load_profile.shape: synthetic burst of create/update/lifecycle-event plans across managers and legal entities

must_assert: employee lifecycle records keep tenant_id, legal_entity_id, manager, data class, and audit evidence
idempotency keys remain unique under concurrent employee lifecycle events
manager reassignment does not cross legal_entity_id boundaries without explicit policy evidence
audit evidence refs are attached for every lifecycle decision
must_reject: employee lifecycle policy bypass count greater than zero
manager reference from another tenant or legal entity
missing audit evidence under burst concurrency

load_profile.shape: synthetic leave, attendance correction, manager routing, and payroll-impact metadata replay

must_assert: leave and attendance decisions preserve manager approval routing evidence
payroll-impact envelopes remain metadata-only and carry payroll accuracy evidence refs
payroll accuracy sampling can replay approved attendance segments without payroll calculation attached
rulepack and workflow refs stay source-versioned and idempotent
must_reject: payroll calculation or network call in this HR scale fixture
attendance segment accepted without manager decision evidence
payroll accuracy sample without rulepack or routing evidence

load_profile.shape: synthetic sensitive-read policy storm for medical/disability/accommodation data classes

must_assert: sensitive-read decisions require purpose and legal basis before allow
tenant/RBAC PDP and audit evidence are prerequisites before runtime boundary access
sensitive-read audit coverage remains 100 percent under concurrency
no sensitive data fetch or raw sensitive data echo appears in outputs
must_reject: sensitive-read allow without purpose or legal basis
missing read-log audit evidence
raw sensitive data echo in traces, logs, or error bodies

load_profile.shape: synthetic KR legal entities crossing 10 and 30 employee thresholds in batch replay

must_assert: 10 employee threshold opens Rules of Employment Workflow evidence path
30 employee threshold opens labor-management council roster, meeting cadence, and minutes evidence
Workflow refs, rulepack refs, and KR evidence refs are stable under batch replay
KR threshold coverage target remains 100 percent for GA without claiming Workflow execution
must_reject: labor-law threshold obligation silently missed
Workflow execution claim in this RED fixture
rulepack ref missing from threshold evidence

load_profile.shape: negative replay that mixes tenant_id, legal_entity_id, idempotency keys, and PDP scope evidence across records

must_assert: cross-tenant replay must fail closed through RLS and PDP evidence checks
legal_entity_id mismatch is rejected before persistence or aggregation
idempotency reservation proof scopes tenant_id plus legal_entity_id
aggregate counters, SLO slices, and error envelopes show no aggregate leakage
must_reject: cross-tenant record accepted
cross-legal-entity idempotency collision accepted
tenant or legal entity identifiers omitted from evidence

load_profile.shape: synthetic saturation replay defining SLO, rollback, OpenTelemetry, abort, and backpressure evidence expectations

must_assert: SLO latency and throughput budgets are named before any load success claim
rollback and abort criteria are explicit before saturation testing
OpenTelemetry traces, metrics, logs, tenant labels, and legal_entity_id labels are evidence requirements
saturation drill remains N/A until live deployment evidence exists
must_reject: SLO success from green CI alone
rollback plan missing
live saturation or production traffic claim

rollout_rollback_observability.production_rollout_na_rationale: N/A until live deployment and reviewed performance Build evidence exist; this fixture defines local/synthetic proof only and no production load test.
rollout_rollback_observability.slo_policy: Define SLO latency, p95/p99, throughput, error-rate, saturation, and burn-rate rollback thresholds before any high-volume success claim.

rollout claim without rollback and abort criteria
